resolved_during_followup.title: Entry-only compilation flag can miss deoptimization during the measured loop
resolved_during_followup.evidence: CompiledEntryProbe.java ran on GraalVM CE with the built Truffle jars and BackgroundCompilation=false; after warming to compiled code, deliberate transferToInterpreterAndInvalidate inside the loop yielded entry=true exit=false sum=4950. Thus the initial flag can pass while loop completion is interpreted. See compiled-entry-probe-retry.log.
resolved_during_followup.resolution: The exact final source saves startedCompiled locally at entry and writes compiled = startedCompiled && CompilerDirectives.inCompiledCode() after the loop. This rejects the demonstrated deoptimization case and interpreted-entry/OSR-only cases while retaining one volatile write per root invocation.

Checks, property reads and printing occur after the elapsed timestamp. Identical harness and VM settings on baseline and candidate are required; no quantitative performance result is inferred from source alone.
